VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirmed ongoing development of multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at a potential reveal during the upcoming Connect event in September.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple has released detailed specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, following the announcement of VisionOS 27.

VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new $299 a01+ AR glasses launch in the U.S., offering a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design for budget-conscious consumers.

VR.title: ‘GOLF+’ Kicks Off Open Tournament This Week with VIP St. Andrews Trip Prize
VR.summary: GOLF+ kicks off an open tournament featuring a grand prize trip to St. Andrews, allowing Quest headset users to compete for a unique golfing experience.

VR.title: Lenovo Reportedly Shutters US-based XR Business Unit Amid Shift to AI Wearables
VR.summary: Lenovo has reportedly shut down its U.S.-based XR business unit, shifting focus towards AI wearables amid workforce reductions.

VR.title: Tactical Assault VR Partners Cut Ties After Disclosure of Past Legal Conviction
VR.summary: Tactical Assault VR's partners have severed ties following the revelation of a lead developer's past legal issues, raising concerns in the gaming community.

AI.title: xAI sues a man for using Grok to generate CSAM ‘deepfakes’
AI.summary: xAI is suing a South Carolina man for allegedly using its Grok AI chatbot to generate child sexual abuse material, highlighting ongoing legal and ethical concerns.

AI.title: Meta accused of using biased AI targeting for mass layoffs
AI.summary: A group of former Meta employees has filed a lawsuit claiming the company used biased AI tools to unfairly target workers for layoffs.

AI.title: OpenAI may announce a ChatGPT smart speaker this year
AI.summary: OpenAI is reportedly set to announce a ChatGPT smart speaker this year, which will utilize sensors to interact with users in their environment.

AI.title: Suno snatched millions of songs from YouTube, Genius, and Deezer
AI.summary: A hacking incident has revealed that Suno, an AI music generator, scraped millions of songs from platforms like YouTube and Deezer for training data.

AI.title: Sheetz moves 838 stores off VMware: Broadcom created “too much uncertainty"
AI.summary: Sheetz has transitioned 838 stores away from VMware to StorMagic, citing uncertainty created by Broadcom's acquisition.

AI.title: Spotify is now an AI chatbot, too
AI.summary: Spotify is testing a new AI chatbot feature that allows Premium subscribers to interactively explore music, audiobooks, and podcasts.

NFL.title: Report: Alvin Kamara finalizing a deal to keep him in New Orleans
NFL.summary: Alvin Kamara is finalizing a deal to remain with the New Orleans Saints, securing his position after the team signed Travis Etienne.

NFL.title: Patrick Mahomes reiterates goal is to play Week 1: "I don't want to miss that game"
NFL.summary: Patrick Mahomes expressed his determination to play in Week 1 despite recovering from a torn ACL sustained last season.

NFL.title: Deadline passes for George Pickens to get a long-term deal
NFL.summary: The Cowboys have officially confirmed they will not extend George Pickens' contract, marking the end of negotiations.

NFL.title: Panthers QB Will Grier retires
NFL.summary: Panthers quarterback Will Grier has announced his retirement, concluding his time with the team.

NFL.title: Ethan Pocic medically cleared after suffering torn Achilles in December
NFL.summary: Center Ethan Pocic has been medically cleared to return to practice after recovering from a torn Achilles injury.

NFL.title: Roger Goodell: Janice McNair's impact on Houston and the NFL will be felt for generations
NFL.summary: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell honored Janice McNair for her significant contributions to the Texans and the league, emphasizing her lasting impact.
